item.title: Community donates over $15,000 during World Famous Pie Auction
item.description: Once again, the community of Boonville came out in full force to support the Boonville R-1 School District’s band program.The Boonville R-1 School District’s band program held their World Famous Pie Auction Friday evening February 6, which was moved from it’s original date due to bad weather at the end of January. This was the 30th year for the pie auction which the band program hosts as a fundraiser.
